notes.title: Gnomer v2.7.5 - The Bow Update
notes.content:
The Knight’s bow releases automatically when held fully charged, so you can focus on dodging gnomes.
 Fixed collisions on Stick Gnome.
 You can now exit build mode using ESC.


Good hunting Knight !

notes.title: Gnomer is out !
notes.content:
Meet Gnomer.
It’s a rogue-lite where you crack open booster packs and turn effect cards into glorious mayhem. Light your arrows on fire. Chain lightning through gnomes. Make enemies detonate. Stack it all until the screen looks like experimental art. Then dive deeper by choosing your next level on a branching map. Build towers to help you shoot gnomes and heal. Unlock new characters, weapons and more ways to make crazy builds. Repeat until the gnomes perish!

Beware: the thrill of ripping a booster pack open and making a build is highly addictive. The game just scratches the brain in the right spot!
